about.title: About DentalMarket
about.body: DentalMarket is a specialized supplier of dental equipment and consumables for clinics, practices, and healthcare centers nationwide. All items carry IMED traceability, official warranty, and FEFO expiry control.

contact.title: Contact Support & B2B Sales
contact.body: Our clinic support and equipment advisory team is available Saturday through Wednesday 9:00–18:00 and Thursdays 9:00–14:00 for technical assistance and official proforma issuance.

returns.title: Returns & Authenticity Guarantee
returns.body: Products with technical discrepancies, transit damage, or batch mismatch can be returned within 7 days of delivery in coordination with our support team.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection
privacy.body: Clinic details, medical council IDs, and purchase histories are used solely for order fulfillment, official invoicing, and stock notifications, and are kept strictly confidential.

warranty.title: Installation, Calibration & Warranty
warranty.body: Capital equipment including dental units, autoclaves, and imaging systems are installed by certified technicians nationwide with 10-year after-sales support.
